verdicts.factCheck: eth_getTransactionReceipt of 0xd80476b3ec56283723804cf7bc2d96f800c81d3ebd0fea843555396ffe94f28f on https://eth.drpc.org returns status 1, block 0x19171d2 (26,309,074), to the Safe 0x5a0aae59d09fccbddb6c6cceb07b7279367c3d2a, and logs on the OP Mainnet portal proxy 0xbeb5fc57 in this order: Upgraded to 0x6d971b07, TransactionDeposited with from 0x5227f603c1ee34ce3c06efe6477003bdfccb2f8c and to 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000042 whose opaque data carries selector a9059cbb and recipient 0x6b1bae59d09fccbddb6c6cceb07b7279367c4e3b, then Upgraded back to 0x1005217a. eth_getStorageAt of the EIP-1967 admin slot of the portal gives ProxyAdmin 0x543ba4aa, whose owner() is 0x5a0aae59, and the implementation slot reads 0xb20b23af today. op-geth core/state_transition.go preCheck (lines 346-360 as fetched) returns for IsDepositTx before any nonce or EOA check, with the comment that L1 already verified it. op-revm handler.rs validate_against_state_and_deduct_caller returns for DEPOSIT_TRANSACTION_TYPE after crediting mint and bumping the nonce, before validate_account_nonce_and_code_with_components. So a deposit whose from is a contract address runs as a call from that contract. I did not re-read the owner() of the eight other ProxyAdmins; the OP Mainnet one matches.
verdicts.codeCheck: Nothing in src/ runs when an outer call originates from the PoolManager address. unlock (src/PoolManager.sol:104-113) and the NonzeroDeltaCount check at line 111 apply only to calls into the PoolManager. take (src/PoolManager.sol:290-296) is never reached; a forged deposit calls the token directly, and the token sees msg.sender equal to the PoolManager. After such a transfer the reserves and pool liquidity in storage no longer match balanceOfSelf, and later takes by LPs and claim holders fail in Currency.transfer. A forged native transfer would lower the PoolManager native balance the same way, since _settle credits msg.value and never reconciles the balance (src/PoolManager.sol:349-355).
